entities.summary: Emilio Simeon Allué Carcasona, SDB was a Spanish-born American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church in the United States. He served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Boston in Massachusetts from 1996 until his retirement in 2010.
